name: pulpit
description: Workspace import rules the boundary zones can't express, because a zone matches the file an import resolves to, not the specifier that names it.

rules.message: Import the kernel by its package name and through its exports (`@thomasfosterau/pulpit`, `@thomasfosterau/pulpit/subtype`, …), never by a relative path into packages/pulpit. See packages/pulpit-wordpress/AGENTS.md → Boundary.
`./registry` and `./content` load in the browser: never import effect-auth (its root entry re-exports node:crypto modules), directly or through ./subtype.ts. See packages/pulpit/AGENTS.md → Boundary.
